verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs say it supports embeddings and reranking for search and context retrieval, and list embeddings among its 100+ supported models. That means a retrieval pipeline can run on the same vendor as inference. The evidence consists only of brief introduction-page mentions. Missing for 10: detailed embeddings/rerank API documentation (endpoints, model list, OpenAI-compatible embeddings usage), independent or hands-on corroboration.
